mapper.select: /* CastExecutionMapper.retrieveSaveDt */ SELECT TO_CHAR(MAX(SAVE_DT), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') FROM ( SELECT OWNER_USER_ID, EXCN_YMD, TMNL_ID, NVL(LAST_MDFCN_DT, FRST_REG_DT) AS SAVE_DT FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_USER_FLT_PSG_AJMT UNION ALL SELECT OWNER_USER_ID, EXCN_YMD, TMNL_ID, NVL(LAST_MDFCN_DT, FRST_REG_DT) FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_USER_CHKN_ISL UNION ALL SELECT OWNER_USER_ID, EXCN_YMD, TMNL_ID, NVL(LAST_MDFCN_DT, FRST_REG_DT) FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_USER_DPTGT ) WHERE OWNER_USER_ID = #{loginUserId} AND EXCN_YMD = #{ymd} AND TMNL_ID = #{fcltTmnlId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT OWNER_USER_ID, EXCN_YMD, TMNL_ID, 'CHKN' AS AREA_CD FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_USER_CHKN_ISL UNION ALL SELECT OWNER_USER_ID, EXCN_YMD, TMNL_ID, 'DEP' AS AREA_CD FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_USER_DPTGT ) WHERE OWNER_USER_ID = #{scope.loginUserId} AND EXCN_YMD = #{scope.ymd} AND TMNL_ID = #{scope.fcltTmnlId} AND AREA_CD = #{area}

/* CastExecutionMapper.reserveRsrcNo */ SELECT RSRC_NO FROM ( SELECT N.RSRC_NO FROM ( SELECT TO_CHAR(#{minNo} + LEVEL - 1, 'FM000') RSRC_NO FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= #{maxNo} - #{minNo} + 1 ) N CROSS JOIN ( SELECT NVL(MAX(U.RSRC_NO), #{minNo} - 1) AS LAST_USED_NO FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(R.RSRC_ID, '^' || #{kind} || '[0-9]{3}$') THEN TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(R.RSRC_ID, 3)) END AS RSRC_NO FROM ( SELECT DECODE(#{kind}, 'FS', FLT_SCHDL_RSRC_ID, PRPT_STNG_RSRC_ID) AS RSRC_ID FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_USER_MSTR UNION ALL SELECT DECODE(#{kind}, 'FS', FLT_SCHDL_RSRC_ID, PRPT_SET_RSRC_ID) FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_STNG ) R ) U WHERE U.RSRC_NO BETWEEN #{minNo} AND #{maxNo} ) L WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_USER_MSTR U WHERE DECODE(#{kind}, 'FS', U.FLT_SCHDL_RSRC_ID, U.PRPT_STNG_RSRC_ID) = #{kind} || N.RSRC_NO ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_STNG S WHERE DECODE(#{kind}, 'FS', S.FLT_SCHDL_RSRC_ID, S.PRPT_SET_RSRC_ID) = #{kind} || N.RSRC_NO )
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_SCHDL_MSTR R WHERE R.SCHDL_ATRB_ID = N.RSRC_NO) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_SCHDL_ATRB R WHERE R.SCHDL_ATRB_GROUP_ID = N.RSRC_NO) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_CKNCT_MSTR R WHERE R.CKNCT_ATRB_ID = N.RSRC_NO) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_CKNCT_ATRB R WHERE R.SCHDL_ATRB_GROUP_ID = N.RSRC_NO) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_SBD_MSTR R WHERE R.SBD_ATRB_ID = N.RSRC_NO) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_SBD_ATRB R WHERE R.SCHDL_ATRB_GROUP_ID = N.RSRC_NO) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_FCLTY_OPNG_DPTGT_MSTR R WHERE R.DPTGT_ATRB_ID = N.RSRC_NO) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_FCLTY_OPNG_DPTGT_ATRB R WHERE R.DPTGT_ATRB_ID = N.RSRC_NO) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_FCLTY_OPNG_SCRTY_CNTRL_MSTR R WHERE R.SCRTY_CNTRL_ATRB_ID = N.RSRC_NO) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_FCLTY_OPNG_SCRTY_CNTRL_ATRB R WHERE R.SCRTY_CNTRL_ATRB_ID = N.RSRC_NO) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_FCLTY_OPNG_ENTCNY_MSTR R WHERE R.ENTCNY_ATRB_ID = N.RSRC_NO) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_FCLTY_OPNG_ENTCNY_ATRB R WHERE R.ENTCNY_ATRB_ID = N.RSRC_NO) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_FCLTY_OPNG_TRNST_SCRTY_CNTRL_MSTR R WHERE R.TRNST_SCRTY_CNTRL_ATRB_ID = N.RSRC_NO) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_FCLTY_OPNG_TRNST_SCRTY_CNTRL_ATRB R WHERE R.TRNST_SCRTY_CNTRL_ATRB_ID = N.RSRC_NO)
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_FIX_ATRB_GROUP G WHERE G.FIX_ATRB_GROUP_ID = N.RSRC_NO) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_PSG_ATRB G WHERE G.FIX_ATRB_GROUP_ID = N.RSRC_NO) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_SHOW_UP_ATRB G WHERE G.FIX_ATRB_GROUP_ID = N.RSRC_NO) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_SRVC_ATRB G WHERE G.FIX_ATRB_GROUP_ID = N.RSRC_NO)
ORDER BY CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(N.RSRC_NO) > L.LAST_USED_NO THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, N.RSRC_NO ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
/* CastExecutionMapper.hasModel */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_STNG WHERE SMLT_ID = #{smltId} AND SMLT_MDL_SN = #{mdlSn}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT S.SMLT_ID, S.EXCN_YMD, S.FLT_SCHDL_RSRC_ID, S.CKNCT_ALCTN_RSRC_ID, S.SBD_CNTRL_ALCTN_ID, S.PRPT_SET_RSRC_ID, S.MDL_RSRC_ID, S.FCLTY_OPNG_DPTCNY_SRNG_RSRC_ID, S.FCLTY_OPNG_EMI_RSRC_ID, S.FCLTY_OPNG_IMMI_RSRC_ID, S.FCLTY_OPNG_SCRTY_CNTRL_RSRC_ID, S.FCLTY_OPNG_TR_SCRTY_CNTRL_RSRC_ID, S.CKNCT_SRVC_HR_RSRC_ID, S.CHKN_TYPE_RSRC_ID, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS RPT_STNG_ATRB_ID, CASE WHEN S.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS PRIORITY, S.SMLT_MDL_SN FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_STNG S WHERE S.SMLT_ID = #{smltId} UNION ALL SELECT U.SMLT_ID, U.EXCN_YMD, U.FLT_SCHDL_RSRC_ID, U.CKNCT_ALCTN_RSRC_ID, U.SBD_CNTRL_ALCTN_ID, U.PRPT_STNG_RSRC_ID, U.MDL_RSRC_ID, U.FCLTY_OPNG_DPTCNY_SRNG_RSRC_ID, U.FCLTY_OPNG_DPTCNY_RSRC_ID, U.FCLTY_OPNG_ENTCNY_RSRC_ID, U.FCLTY_OPNG_SCRTY_CNTRL_RSRC_ID, U.FCLTY_OPNG_TR_SCRTY_CNTRL_RSRC_ID, U.CKNCT_SRVC_HR_RSRC_ID, U.CHKN_TYPE_RSRC_ID, U.RPT_STNG_ATRB_ID, 2, 0 FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_USER_MSTR U WHERE U.SMLT_ID = #{smltId} ORDER BY PRIORITY, SMLT_MDL_SN ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
